{{Quote|I'm just here for the ride. If you could drop me off somewhere in the Juvex sector, though, I'd be extremely grateful.|[[Droma]]|<ref name="Reunion">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref>}}
The '''Juvex sector''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] bordering the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]], and near the [[Ninth Quadrant]]. The two sectors made up the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the sector included [[Juvex]] itself. The sector was ruled by [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Ancient Houses|houses]] who engaged in the [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Merchant/Legends|trade]], including [[House Sreethyn]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained only a token presence in the sector, and it never joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a central focus of the [[Ismaren plot]].<ref name="CotJ" />
